slot_scores.name: max_shifts_per_week
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is there a limit on how many days per week a single student can be scheduled (e.g., a student cannot work more than 3 days out of the 5), or can a student work on any or all 5 days as long as the daily caps and weekly minimums are satisfied?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked about a weekly limit on the number of days/shifts per student, and followed up to clarify the meaning of the limit.

slot_scores.name: max_students_per_day
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is there a maximum number of students who can be assigned shifts on any single day, or is there no limit on how many students can work in a day as long as the 14-hour partition is satisfied?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent directly asked whether there is a daily cap on the number of distinct students assigned to duty.

slot_scores.name: objective_minimize_gross_pay
slot_scores.evidence_quote: The model should minimize total weekly labor cost (sum of wage × hours for each student-day), subject to the 14-hour daily coverage, the weekly minimums (8h undergrad, 7h grad), and the hard daily caps — is that the correct objective, or is there a different objective (e.g., minimize total hours, maximize fairness, etc.)?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked about the optimization objective and confirmed minimizing total weekly labor cost.
